title: Acquire a finite endpoint equation without assuming infinitesimal pulses
statement: The entire paired-energy family over complex directions, two distinct positive radii and an open pulse-time interval has no nonzero real-Sym4 null tensor for a connected network. Generic finite spanning uses at mostbinomial(n+3,4)paired settings under a full-density JOINT parameter law; it supplies no useful uniform singular-value lower bound or cheap finite noisy design.
